correctness.rationale: Pick and lattice Cartesian product imply the precise cubic. The exact standalone symbolic certificate expands the discriminant in exhaustive disjoint parameter chambers: 72 and 25 strictly positive monomial coefficients except one zero constant, with only the stated isolated double-root corner. Positive nonzero coefficients force all real zeros negative; finite samples are not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: A natural complete classification shows segment multiplication restores real-rootedness even for polygons whose numerator has complex roots, and identifies the unique repeated-root parameter boundary. It is a structural root-location theorem covering unbounded base geometry and small widths, rather than a routine finite enumeration.
